requirements.text: The vendor must provide a cloud-based accounting and financial reporting software system, acquired and implemented for the City.
requirements.quote: acquisition and implementation of a cloud-based accounting and financial reporting software system

requirements.text: The solution must capture financial transactions systematically and efficiently, including budgeting and forecasting capabilities.
requirements.quote: A streamlined software package that captures financial transactions in a systematic, efficient manner, including budgeting and forecasting capabilities.

requirements.text: The solution must be able to generate reports and analyze data to support informed decision-making.
requirements.quote: Ability to generate reports and analyze data effectively to support informed decision-making.

requirements.text: The solution must maintain auditable records and documentation for future reference.
requirements.quote: Ability to maintain auditable records and documentation for future reference.

requirements.text: The vendor must provide dedicated technical support during implementation and throughout annual contract renewals.
requirements.quote: Dedicated technical support during implementation and throughout annual contract renewals.

requirements.text: The vendor must provide complete support for both initial implementation and ongoing services for all applications it provides.
requirements.quote: The scope of this RFP includes complete support for both the initial implementation and ongoing services for all applications provided by the selected software vendor.

checklist.fact: The City of Colfax, California (a small city in Placer County with a population just under 2,000) is issuing the RFP.
checklist.quote: The City of Colfax (City) is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP)

checklist.fact: The City is procuring acquisition and implementation of a cloud-based accounting and financial reporting software system, including initial implementation and ongoing services for all applications provided by the selected vendor.
checklist.quote: solicit comprehensive proposals for the acquisition and implementation of a cloud-based accounting and financial reporting software system

checklist.fact: The City currently uses Fund Balance fund accounting software from Tyler Technologies (modules: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Payroll, Utility Billing, Business Licensing), with five users.
checklist.quote: Currently, the City utilizes Fund Balance fund accounting software from Tyler Technologies

checklist.fact: Key objectives include a streamlined package capturing financial transactions with budgeting and forecasting, effective reporting and data analysis, auditable records, and dedicated technical support during implementation and annual contract renewals.
checklist.quote: Dedicated technical support during implementation and throughout annual contract renewals.

checklist.fact: Proposals are due Thursday, August 28, 2025 at 4:00 PM PST, by email plus an original hard copy, and late proposals will not be considered.
checklist.quote: Proposals received after the deadline will not be considered or evaluated.

checklist.fact: The RFP was issued July 1, 2025; written questions are due July 31, 2025, answers posted August 14, finalists notified September 11, interviews September 25, and contract award October 22, 2025.
The City's goal is to complete implementation and go live on July 1, 2026, in coordination with the new fiscal year.
checklist.quote: The goal is to complete implementation by July 1, 2026, for the new fiscal year.

checklist.fact: Scope of work has four tasks: project management plan, software installation and implementation (including importing the prior 5 years of data), staff training with support for the first 12 months post-implementation, and ongoing technical assistance and support (including 1099 and W-2 e-filing).
checklist.quote: Import prior 5 years data for history.

checklist.fact: Proposals are evaluated 45% on response to project goals and scope, 25% on technical support, 20% on fee proposal and implementation schedule, and 10% on information, qualifications and references.
checklist.quote: **45%** Response to project goals and scope

checklist.fact: The RFP states no budget or price ceiling, but reimbursable expenses cannot be unlimited and must be capped in the price proposal.
checklist.quote: Any proposed reimbursable expenses must be capped in the price proposal.

checklist.fact: Respondents must provide documentation of measures protecting financial data and secure access controls (Attachment G), and disclose any use of workers outside the United States (Attachment C).
checklist.quote: Provide documentation demonstrating the measures in place for protecting financial data and the secure access controls implemented.

checklist.fact: Attachment F (Software Abilities and Requirements spreadsheet) is a separate Excel document provided by the City and not included in this PDF; the City's standard contract is available only upon request.
checklist.quote: (This is a separate document provided by the City).
